name: Songscription
tagline: Turn any audio into sheet music, MIDI, and guitar tabs with AI.
description: Songscription transcribes audio recordings into readable notation — sheet music, MIDI, MusicXML, and GuitarPro tabs — across instruments including piano, guitar, bass, strings, horns, drums, and vocals. Often described as a 'Shazam for sheet music', it automates a task that traditionally took hours by ear. A free tier covers unlimited 30-second clips, with paid plans for longer recordings and more export formats.
insight: Stanford-founded; its model builds on co-founder Tim Beyer's research, backed by Reach Capital through Stanford's StartX accelerator.
edge: Outputs real, readable notation across many instruments — where rivals stop at separated stems or rough text transcripts.

references.title: Songscription launches an AI-powered 'Shazam for sheet music'
